steps.en: Review the skill, place it in the host's skill directory, and restart the host
steps.zh: 审阅技能，放入宿主技能目录并重启

steps.en: Supply a subject or authorized photo, exact text, and any required one-ink constraint
steps.zh: 提供主题或授权照片、准确文案和单色要求

steps.en: Resolves a recipe and compiles the five-paragraph image prompt
steps.zh: 确定配方并编成五段生图提示词

steps.en: Uses an available image tool, or discloses prompt-only delivery
steps.zh: 使用已有生图工具，否则说明只交提示词

steps.en: Inspects the image, retries once on failures, and returns the image, prompt, and recipe
steps.zh: 检查图片，失败重试一次，交付图片、提示与配方

value.en: An editorial print direction without rebuilding the ink, crop, and typography brief each time
value.zh: 不必每次重新拼装油墨、裁切与字体要求
